answer: Weight follows disjoint vouch depth, not headcount. Each fresh identity must post 500 POA bond in escrow for 6 epochs, backed by three peers with settled history and separate deposit roots. Peers audit real work each epoch; a failed audit will slash the bond, burn the holdback collateral and eject the key. A public mirror lists every deposit so one sponsor cannot back two keys twice. Fifty fake keys need fifty bonds, fifty deposits and fifty waits for one vote. Honest weight climbs epoch by epoch from a relic of proven history toward its zenith.
